pattern: ものと思われる / ものと見られる（ものとおもわれる / ものとみられる）
aliases: mono to omowareru / mono to mirareru
ものとおもわれる / ものとみられる
purpose: Present a conclusion as an evidence-based assessment.
keywords: Plain clause + ものと思われる / ものと見られる
Moisture is believed to have caused the failure.
Demand is expected to keep growing.
The ruins are thought to be a thousand-year-old building.
formation: Plain clause + ものと思われる / ものと見られる
restrictions: Common in reports; the assessor is often left unnamed.
mistake: It signals an inference, not direct observation of the conclusion.
